title: Stash and restore drafts in the Claude pane's box
notes: Claude Code: Ctrl+S stashes a draft; Up brings back a cleared draft (last 10). Pane: Up keeps only the one draft from before the history walk (chat-view.ts:345). Size S.

comments.body: Shipped in #123: Alt+S stashes the box's draft and empties it; Up walks the stash (newest first, last 10 kept) before the prompts sent. Released as 2.27.0. Needs app rebuild and a hand check.
